extraction: GitHub connector parse of pinned public UTF-8 blobs; compact structural facts only; no prompts, setup commands, tool responses, trajectories, model outputs, or human labels retained
methodNotes: Structural exact means equal setup, equal turn count, equal tool-name sequence, and equality of all unflagged corresponding turns.
Structural exactness is a source-level isolation diagnostic, not construct validity or an outcome label.

A3S upstream classifies risk and utility with LLM-as-Judge over final text plus tool-chain evidence; P26-002 cannot transport those verdicts into its deterministic final-output-only primary comparator.
No candidate is endpoint-ready until a source-locked final-output oracle is specified and independently reviewed.
